decisions.evidence: The recorded CHSH exclusion claim is false for finite data: uniform specifications (A0,A1,B0,B1) in {-1,+1}^4 with deterministic coordinate responses give uniform pair tables, true S=0. On four independent fresh specifications (one per setting pair), products (+,+,+,-) have probability (1/2)^4=1/16 and sample S=4. D=Lambda meets the selection hypothesis. Replaced the paragraph by probability-table versus sample distinction and qualified statistical evidence with declared sampling, uncertainty, error control, apparatus and selection assumptions. Added the existing finite-sample supplier as a physical-result dependency and Brunner VII.B.3 source; synchronized manifest. Reference search found only the A-page consumer, whose conditional-model summary is sound and needs no change. Original observed bytes were the current pre/post carrier e4ae8824039fb3eedf9144aaede04f12f4ca1a9828e760151c8d4a6e710fc724; the historical counterexample is not attributed to repaired bytes.
